newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australia 10-yr bond eyes pre-budget peak.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australia 10-yr bond eyes pre-budget peak.

text.p: *Australian bond futures extended Thursday's rally in after hours trading with the 10-year contract close to retesting the 11-week 92.370 peak seen prior to Tuesday's budget.
*U.S. Treasuries ended with modest price gains, erasing their early falls, after a mixed bag of data.
Australian bond futures extended Thursday's rally in after-hours trading with the 10-year contract close to re-testing the 11-week 92.370 peak seen prior to Tuesday's federal budget.
The June 10-year contract ended SYCOM trade at 92.350 and up on Thursday's 92.305 pit close, building on the solid bounce from this week's 92.180 low.
A break of the 92.360/92.370 area is expected to find further resistance at 92.410, while any retracement is expected to be confined to support at around 92.270 to 92.250 for now, analysts said.
The local firm tone in SYCOM came against a backdrop of a volatile U.S. Treasury market which finished with modest price gains, erasing their early falls after a mixed bag of data.

The market was knocked back by a 0.3 percent jump in core April CPI inflation and a fall in weekly jobless claims, but was later soothed by flat industrial production and a small fall in capacity utilisation.
Also aiding the recovery was the Philadelphia Federal Reserve Index showing business conditions had fallen in May and a recovery in the U.S. dollar against the yen.

The U.S. market now waits for next Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting with the possibility of a Fed tightening still lingering, although data such as this week's PPI have seen lessened the concerns to some extent, economists added.
